plugin.note: Cave slime has Defence level 35 but no defensive bonuses, so any melee weapon works. Earth spells exploit the 50% elemental weakness for a Magic alternative. A light source is required to enter the caves, and Cave slime poisons on hit, so bring antipoison.

requirements: 17 Slayer and combat level 15 are required to be assigned Cave slime.
A light source is required to enter the Lumbridge Swamp Caves; an enclosed lantern is safer than an open flame.
Antipoison is recommended, as Cave slime poisons on hit (poison damage level 3).
mechanics: Cave slime is poisonous (poison damage level 3) and is NOT undead, so the salve amulet does not apply.
It has a 50% elemental weakness to earth spells despite Defence level 35.
It attacks with melee (stab) at 4 ticks with a max hit of 2.
A Dwarf multicannon can be used in the Lumbridge Swamp Caves.

methods.label: Any melee weapon
methods.summary: Bring a light source and antipoison, then kill Cave slime with any melee weapon in the Lumbridge Swamp Caves.
steps: Equip a light source and enter the Lumbridge Swamp Caves via the rope hole.
Kill the Cave slime; the lack of defensive bonuses makes weapon choice unimportant.
Drink antipoison as needed; Cave slime poisons on hit.
notes: Watch for wall beasts on the way in; a spiny helmet protects against them.

methods.label: Dwarf multicannon
methods.summary: Set up a Dwarf multicannon in the caves to speed up the low-density task.
steps: Enter the Lumbridge Swamp Caves with a light source.
Place a Dwarf multicannon and clear the Cave slime spawns.
Alternatively cast earth spells to exploit the 50% elemental weakness.
notes: Earth spells are the fastest non-cannon option thanks to the 50% earth weakness.
